theorems.name: Submission.dtc_bc_lr_lipschitz_near_point
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (f : Euclid P → Euclid P) (x : Euclid P) (δ c : ℝ), 0 < δ → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 f (ball x δ) → ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ ≤ c → ∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s ≤ δ ∧ ∀ y ∈ ball x s, ∀ z ∈ ball x s, ‖f y - f z‖ ≤ (c + η) * ‖y - z‖
